description: Source code for Lua's stack and call structure management, including error recovery, stack reallocation, coroutine handling, and function call mechanisms.

methods.name: luaD_seterrorobj
methods.description: Sets the error object on the stack based on error code.

methods.name: luaD_throw
methods.description: Throws an error with specified error code, handling panic if no error jump buffer.

methods.name: luaD_rawrunprotected
methods.description: Runs a function in a protected environment, catching errors.

methods.name: luaD_reallocstack
methods.description: Reallocates the stack to a new size and adjusts references.

methods.name: luaD_reallocCI
methods.description: Reallocates CallInfo array to a new size.

methods.name: luaD_growstack
methods.description: Grows the stack size, doubling or adding specified amount.

methods.name: luaD_precall
methods.description: Prepares a function call, handling Lua and C functions differently.

methods.name: luaD_poscall
methods.description: Completes a function call, moving results to the correct position.

methods.name: luaD_call
methods.description: Calls a function (C or Lua), managing call stack and execution.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a coroutine, handling initial start or continuation after yield.

methods.name: lua_resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended coroutine, protected execution and error handling.

methods.name: lua_yield
methods.description: Yields a coroutine, saving state and setting status.

methods.name: luaD_pcall
methods.description: Protected call to a function with error handling and cleanup.

methods.name: luaD_protectedparser
methods.description: Executes a parser in protected mode, handling errors.
